lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section and narrows slightly towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 10th, 11th, and 12th vertical lines (counting from the shoulder) are abbreviated, terminating before crossing the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of approximately 5-6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white markings on the muzzle and surrounding the eyes, plus a prominent white crescent-shaped patch on the lower neck/throat area.
